title: Blue bond

definition.text: A blue bond is the ocean version of a green bond: it raises money specifically for ocean conservation and sustainable marine activity.

facts.text: Like green bonds, blue bonds earmark money for eligible environmental projects and usually follow voluntary guidance on use of proceeds, project selection, management and reporting.
Labelled bonds tied to sustainable fisheries, such as the Seychelles sovereign blue bond, are discussed as a way to bring private capital to nature.
